cases.description: Verify disabled Edit button and Print Preview UI
steps: 1. Launch the app and wait for the splash screen.
4. On Sign Up screen, tap  "Sign Up Later".
7. Verify "Sprocket would like to access the Camera" popup appears.
9. Verify Photo ID Mode onboarding popup appears.
11. Verify Photo ID camera screen appears with Front Camera selected by default.
12. Verify 2×2 ratio is selected by default.
15. Position the face inside the oval guide.
17. Wait for image capture to complete.
18. Verify Photo ID Print Preview screen opens.
19. Verify Back Arrow icon is displayed at the top-left corner.
20. Verify printer name "HP Sprocket Studio Plus 66:FE" is displayed in the header.
21. Verify Share icon is displayed at the top-right corner.
22. Verify captured photo preview is displayed in 1.3×1.9 format.
23. Verify dotted gray border surrounds the photo.
24. Verify size label "1.3×1.9 in" is displayed below the photo.
26. Verify copies count shows 1 by default.
27. Verify Minus (-) and Plus (+) icons are displayed beside the copies counter.
28. Tap + icon and verify copies count increases.
29. Tap - icon and verify copies count decreases and does not go below 1.
30. Verify AI button is displayed in disabled state.
31. Verify Print button is enabled and highlighted in green.
32. Verify Edit button is displayed in disabled state.
34. Verify tooltip message "Edit is not available for Photo ID." appears above the Edit button.
37. Verify bottom navigation bar displays More, Create, and Printer tabs.
38. Verify Create tab is highlighted by default.
cases.expected: Print Preview screen displays all UI elements correctly. AI and Edit buttons are disabled. Tooltip message appears for 5 seconds and disappears automatically. Copies counter works correctly and Create tab is highlighted by defualt.
